texts.zh:
[From.GetName]上的建筑并没有我们最初想的那么古老。它似乎是某种游乐场。科学专员[Root.GetLeaderName]表示，这些奇妙的装置异常复杂，我们能从中学到很多。在它们建造者的视角中，这可能是尖端的传感阵列，也可能是巨大的艺术设施。

然而，在我们[Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural]看来，这看起来更像是你会带着小孩子去玩的地方。
texts.en:
The structures on [From.GetName] are not as old as we first believed. It is a playground or amusement park of some sort. Science Officer [Root.GetLeaderName] notes that many of the contraptions are highly complex creations that we can learn much from and that, from the builders' alien point of view, this might have been a cutting-edge sensor array or even a gigantic art installation.

Regardless, to us [Root.Owner.GetSpeciesNamePlural], it looks mostly like a place where you would take your young and let them amuse themselves.
